```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
ScenarioConfig <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "runScenarios.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
INPUT_ID <- as.character(ScenarioConfig$InputID)
SCENARIO_P <- as.numeric(ScenarioConfig$P)
if (length(INPUT_ID) != 1L || !nzchar(INPUT_ID) ||
    length(SCENARIO_P) != 1L || !is.finite(SCENARIO_P)) {
  stop("scenarios.scaling: invalid scenario family contract.", call. = FALSE)
}
PathSummary <- file.path(root, "data", "audit", "summary.csv")
PathScenarios <- file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv")
PathSource <- file.path(root, "data", "gmsp", INPUT_ID, "IMW.csv")
if (any(!file.exists(c(PathSummary, PathScenarios, PathSource)))) {
  stop("scenarios.scaling: required scenario products are missing.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
SCENARIO_SUMMARY <- data.table::fread(
  PathSummary,
  select = c(
    "ScenarioID", "D", "MIC", "SF.L", "SF.T", "SF.V", "n.records"
  )
)
SCENARIO_SOURCE <- data.table::fread(
  PathSource,
  select = c("RecordID", "OCID", "PGV")
)
SCENARIO_N <- unique(SCENARIO_SUMMARY$n.records)
if (length(SCENARIO_N) != 1L || !is.finite(SCENARIO_N) ||
    SCENARIO_N < 1L) {
  stop("scenarios.scaling: scenarios have inconsistent realization counts.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
SCENARIO_M <- data.table::uniqueN(SCENARIO_SUMMARY$ScenarioID)
if (!is.finite(SCENARIO_M) || SCENARIO_M < 1L) {
  stop("scenarios.scaling: scenario inventory is empty.", call. = FALSE)
}
SCENARIO_META <- unique(data.table::fread(
  PathScenarios,
  select = c("ScenarioID", "D", "MIC", "P", "RecordID")
))[P == SCENARIO_P]
if (!exists("COMPONENT_LABELS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  COMPONENT_LABELS <- c(
    L = "longitudinal",
    T = "transverse",
    V = "vertical"
  )
}
if (!exists("TABS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  TABS <- c(L = "Longitudinal", T = "Transverse", V = "Vertical")
}
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste(
    "Exact PPV-based scale factor $\\lambda_{s,r,c}=",
    "\\mathrm{PPV}^{\\mathrm{tar}}_{s,c}/\\mathrm{PGV}_{r,c}$ for source",
    "component %s. The matrix contains %s source histories and %s $D$--$Q$",
    "conditions at predictive level $p=%s$; each cell represents one scenario",
    "and source-history combination. Columns are ordered by $D$ and then $Q$,",
    "and the common history order is retained across L, T, and V. The color",
    "scale is logarithmic; the interactive label reports the exact factor,",
    "target PPV, and source",
    "PGV. $\\lambda=1$ denotes no amplitude modification, $\\lambda>1$",
    "amplification, and $\\lambda<1$ attenuation. All individual values are",
    "shown. Marks at 2, 5, 10, 20, and 50 are multiplicative reading",
    "references, not acceptance criteria."
  )
}
if (!exists("X_AXIS", inherits = FALSE)) X_AXIS <- "Scenario condition"
if (!exists("Y_AXIS", inherits = FALSE)) Y_AXIS <- "Source history"
if (!exists("SERIES_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) SERIES_LABEL <- "λ [-]"
if (!exists("TOOLTIP_FORMAT", inherits = FALSE)) {
  TOOLTIP_FORMAT <- paste0(
    "Scenario: <b>{point.scenario}</b><br>",
    "D: <b>{point.d} m</b> | Q (MIC): <b>{point.q} kg</b><br>",
    "Record identifier: <b>{point.record}</b> | Component: <b>{point.component}</b><br>",
    "Target PPV: <b>{point.target} mm/s</b><br>",
    "Source PGV: <b>{point.pgv} mm/s</b><br>",
    "Scale factor λ: <b>{point.lambda}</b>"
  )
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

#| label: fig-scenarios-scaling-l
#| fig-cap: !expr sprintf(CAP, COMPONENT_LABELS[["L"]], SCENARIO_N, SCENARIO_M, formatC(SCENARIO_P, format = "f", digits = 2L))
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
COMPONENT <- "L"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "scenarios.scaling.R"))
PLOT

rm(
  CAP, COMPONENT, COMPONENT_LABELS, INPUT_ID, PLOT, PathScenarios, PathSource,
  PathSummary, SCENARIO_M, SCENARIO_META, SCENARIO_N, SCENARIO_P,
  SCENARIO_SOURCE, SCENARIO_SUMMARY, SERIES_LABEL, ScenarioConfig, TABS,
  TOOLTIP_FORMAT, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS
)
